title: wk AI Tools Recovery
desc: Recovery notes for wrappers, cache files, and smoke tests.
steps: Wrapper locations are D:/GitHub/WKAppBot/bin/wkclaude.ps1, wkgemini.sh, and wkcodex.cmd
Session cache wk_agent_best_model.json stores the last successful auto model
Failure cache wk_agent_model_sessions slash alias dot json stores status, reason, first_line, first_token_ms, last_ok, last_fail, and cooldown_until
If cache looks stale or wrong, delete temp session files and rerun a short smoke test
If wrapper paths change, update routing notes first and retest the shortest path end to end

requirements.expect: returns wrapper and cache recovery notes
